scenarios.scenario: Open ribbon customization from the Tools tab in its first captured state

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon tab is selected
ribbon customization has not been opened earlier in the captured session
the user clicks "Customize" in the Options panel
the customization dialog opens on the "Ribbon" tab
the target selector shows "Part | Tools"
the available-command category is "All Commands"
the Part | Tools custom panel list is empty beneath the "Large", "Text" and "Name" columns
"Import", "Export" and "Close" are available
"Cancel" and "Apply" are unavailable
no customization change is pending
the user clicks "Close"
the dialog closes and the Tools ribbon remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Preserve a staged ribbon edit while viewing keyboard customization

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon customization dialog has an empty Part Tools custom panel
the user adds "2D Sketches" to the custom panel
the user selects the "Keyboard" customization tab
the keyboard command list is displayed
"Apply" and "Cancel" remain available
the user returns to the "Ribbon" customization tab
"2D Sketches" remains in the Part Tools custom panel list
the target indicates a pending change
the user clicks "Cancel"
the customization dialog closes
no User Commands panel appears on the Tools ribbon

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

"2D Sketches" is available in the source list

the target indicates a pending change
the user double-clicks "2D Sketches" in the custom panel list
the custom panel list is empty
